sources.title: Luminary AI — Ask, Explore, & Understand Anything
sources.snippet: Luminary is an AI-powered exploration and understanding platform that transforms how people engage with information by making it easier to explore, analyze, and apply. Use Luminary to ask about anything, explore what you find, and understand it better, all in one place. Try it for free on the web or download the free app.

sources.title: Multiverse Computing unveils Luminary, an AI test for chatbot models
sources.snippet: Luminary uses simulations to model both customers and backend systems, revealing failure points like lost context or misused tools before deployment. "Every enterprise AI programme starts with the same question, and almost nobody answers it with evidence: which model should we actually run?" says Multiverse Computing, offering Luminary as the solution.
